observations: Photo 0 shows a black Canon DSLR camera with a lens attached, held in hand. The camera body has 'Canon' and 'EOS 1300D' clearly visible on the top right. The lens has a 'Canon' logo and focus distance markings (18-24, 24-35, 35-55).

Photo 1 shows the top and front of the camera, with the mode dial, shutter button, and hot shoe visible. The lens barrel has 'Canon' and focal length markings. A watermark 'MCSTEVE POSTED ON JIJI' is present on both photos.
The camera appears to be in used condition with some minor scuffs and dust on the lens and body. No signs of major damage or wear are visible.
No screen, battery, charger, or accessories are shown in the photos.

claims.claim: This Canon EOS 1300D DSLR Camera is as clean and New like a new one from the Box it was not used for...
claims.evidence: Photos show minor scuffs and dust on the lens and body, which contradicts 'new like a new one from the box' and 'not used' claims. No proof of original packaging or full condition.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function properly (e.g., sensor damage, shutter failure, or software issues).
risks.proof: Video of the camera powering on, showing the LCD screen, menu navigation, and taking a test photo.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal scratches, fungus, or focus issues not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Close-up video of the lens focusing and zooming, and a test photo taken with the lens.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens with potential defects

risks.risk: Battery or charger may be missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger included, or a video showing the battery charging and camera powering on.

risks.risk: Camera may have been tampered with or have hidden damage (e.g., cracked sensor, water damage).
risks.proof: Photo of the camera's serial number and a close-up of the sensor (if possible) or a video of the camera in operation.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a test photo.
Close-up video of the lens focusing and zooming.
Photo of the battery and charger included.
Photo of the camera's serial number and a close-up of the sensor if possible.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
